fact_text: The government raised Rs118 billion through an Ijara sukuk issue, mostly in one-year and three-year tenors, with a smaller five-year piece.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Cut-off yields on the sukuk ranged between about 11.5% and 11.75%, above the 10.5% policy rate.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The State Bank policy (discount) rate was 10.5% in March 2026.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Islamic banks earn good returns on sukuk because Islamic treasury pricing pays them well; the analyst named Meezan Bank, the largest Islamic bank, as the main focus of investors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Pakistan's workers' remittances totalled roughly $29-30 billion over the first eight to nine months of FY26, according to the analyst's tally.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The analyst estimated remittances could top $40 billion by June 2026 if the record monthly pace continued.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The analyst said the Gulf-region conflict could disrupt these inflows, and expected the flow to hold for about three to five months before a fresh review.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: A PIA holding entity formed through the privatisation has taken a stake that sits within Fauji Fertilizer's portfolio, which the analyst said is growing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 26 Mar 2026 | Govt Raises Rs118B via Sukuk | Remittances Hit $30B |FFC Stock Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's gas costs about Rs500-600 per MMBTU; the analyst expected gas shortfall headlines to have little effect because its dedicated low-calorific supply is secure.

fact_text: The analyst projected Fauji Fertilizer's first-quarter earnings at about Rs11-12 per share, a figure he said was revised lower for the year.

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer pays a dividend in every quarter.
